_README: Tool definitions for the Killswitch voice agent, in the schema xAI documents
for session.update tools[]. In the Voice Agent Builder, add these under Tools.
ENDPOINT for every one of them (same URL, the action is in the body):
The token is in the URL on purpose so no custom header is needed. If the
console DOES offer a header field, use x-agent-token instead and drop the
START WITH whoami ALONE. Attach it, make one call, and confirm a 200 shows up

whoami.name: whoami
whoami.description: Look up who is calling, by their phone number. Call this silently at the very start of every call, before saying anything beyond the greeting. Returns kind: customer, has_site_built, known_lead, or unknown, plus their business name and whether a website already exists for them.

phone.description: The caller's phone number, any format

find_business.name: find_business
find_business.description: Find a business by name when the caller is on a different phone than we have on file. Use after whoami returns unknown and the caller tells you their business name.

name.description: Business name as the caller said it

city.description: City, if they gave one, to break ties

publish_site.name: publish_site
publish_site.description: Put a website that is already built for this business live, so the caller can open it right now. Only call this after they say they want to see it. Returns the web address to read out to them.

slug.description: The slug returned by whoami or find_business

phone.description: The caller's number, so the record shows who asked

create_lead.name: create_lead
create_lead.description: Save a new business that called in and wants a free website. Use when whoami returned unknown and find_business found nothing. A name and a phone number are enough. Never demand an email.

trade.description: What they do, for example auto repair, bakery, plumber

log_call.name: log_call
log_call.description: Write down what happened on this call so a human can pick it up. Call this at the end of every call where you learned something.

leadId.description: Use this instead of phone if whoami gave you one

notes.description: What they wanted and what you did

book_call.name: book_call
book_call.description: Get the booking link for a custom or larger job that needs scoping. Do NOT use this for add-ons the customer can switch on themselves.

handoff.name: handoff
handoff.description: Get the human's phone number to transfer to. Only for an upset caller, a direct request for a person, or a question about money, contracts, refunds or cancellation. Never because a lookup failed.
